newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices fall sharply.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices fall sharply.

text.p: Prices on the Istanbul gold exchange dropped to $354.00 an ounce on Wednesday from Tuesday's $358.30 in line with falling worldwide gold values.
Volume eased to 750 kg from 898 on Tuesday, with players cautious due to expectations of further price falls in the longer term, dealers said.
Gold's slide in dollar terms was enough to drag down the lira price to 1,277,300 lira per gramme at Wednesday's close from 1,291,700 on Tuesday, despite the lira weakening against the dollar.
The lira closed at 112,400 to the dollar versus 111,750 on Tuesday.
Of the volume traded 97.3 percent was conducted in lira terms.
